items.rationale: The narrative cites no prior literature or label association linking Drug A to hepatic injury. Outside knowledge is not admissible here.
Drug A was started on 3 January and the injury presented on 18 January, a clear and plausible temporal sequence.
items.evidence_text: was started on Drug A, an oral antifungal agent, on 3 January for onychomycosis

items.rationale: Liver enzymes normalised after Drug A was discontinued, which is a positive dechallenge.
items.evidence_text: Liver enzymes declined gradually and had normalised by 10 February, with ALT 31 U/L

items.rationale: Explicitly no rechallenge. The narrative states the patient was not re-exposed, so this item is uninformative rather than negative.
items.evidence_text: The patient was not re-exposed to Drug A
